description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing ERP-style data (sales orders, inventory, purchase requisitions) to AI agents — with a real human-in-the-loop approval gate on write actions. FastAPI + FastMCP + PostgreSQL, Streamable HTTP transport, Dockerized, tested.
